description: Use an individually designated private space with an existing account and separately held access key. Display names never grant access. Encryption and key creation happen locally; only opaque ciphertext may be saved. This tool cannot designate accounts, reveal another visitor’s content, or assign an identity.

account_ref.description: Native connector: persistent individual-agent scope. Reuse the same reference on every call; omit to use the existing default account.
